ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-01.prompt: What is the product of the mean, the median and the mode of the numbers 2, 0, 2 and 5?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-02.prompt: The four angles of a quadrilateral are $3x^\circ$, $4x^\circ$, $5x^\circ$ and $6x^\circ$. What is the size of the largest angle in the quadrilateral?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-03.prompt: The population of a strain of bacteria doubles every day. There are now 5000 bacteria. After how many days will there be more than one million bacteria?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-04.prompt: 2025 is the product of six prime numbers. What is their sum?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-05.prompt: What is one third of one quarter of one fifth of £30 (in pounds)?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-06.prompt: After playing four football matches, Liverton FC had scored a mean of 2 goals per match. After the next match, their mean was 3 goals per match. How many goals did they score in the fifth match?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-07.prompt: What is the difference between the sum of the first five square numbers and twice the sum of the first five triangular numbers?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-08.prompt: Alan wants to fill in the $4\times4$ square so that the letters U, K, M and T occur once each in every row and column, and in both main diagonals. The given letters are: row 1: U, M in the first two squares; row 2: K in the second square; row 4: T in the last square. Which letter must go in the square with the question mark (row 3, last square)?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-09.prompt: Pip accidentally increased the prices in a sale by 10% instead of decreasing them by 10%. He decides to reduce the new prices by 20%. What percentage discount from the original price do customers now receive?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-10.prompt: Last year Alice was three times as old as Fred. Next year she will be twice as old as Fred. How old will Alice be next year?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-11.prompt: A newspaper is made of 31 pieces of paper folded in half. The first sheet contains pages 1, 2, 123 and 124. What is the sum of the page numbers on the sheet containing page 35?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-12.prompt: Johnny takes part in a triathlon. He swims 1.5 km at a speed of 5 km/h, cycles 40 km at a speed of 40 km/h and runs 10 km at a speed of 20 km/h. He also takes a total of 48 seconds for the two transitions. What is his total time in hours, minutes and seconds?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-13.prompt: What are the coordinates of the point where the lines $y=3x+1$ and $x=y$ intersect?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-14.prompt: My bath fills up with water from the hot tap at a rate of 10 litres/min and from the cold tap at a rate of 13 litres/min. It empties down the plug hole at a rate of 15 litres/min. My bath was empty when I turned on both taps, but I forgot to put the plug in. How many seconds did it take to fill my 60 litre bathtub?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-15.prompt: A Reuleaux triangle is a curve with constant width. It is made by drawing arcs with centres at each vertex of an equilateral triangle which join the other two vertices, as shown. The sides of the equilateral triangle have length 5 cm. What is the perimeter of this Reuleaux triangle?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-16.prompt: The sum of two numbers is 45. The difference between them is 5. What is their product?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-17.prompt: The mean, the median and the mode of five positive integers is eight. What is the maximum possible range of the numbers?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-18.prompt: The angles in a pentagon are $40^\circ$, $50^\circ$, $2x^\circ$, $3x^\circ$ and $4x^\circ$. What is the size of the largest angle of the pentagon?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-19.prompt: The Wimbledon Tennis competition for men involves 128 competitors who all play in a knockout. Those who lose in the first round leave the competition and those who win proceed to the next round. This continues until an overall winner is found. How many matches are played to decide the winner?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-20.prompt: A group of six students had a mean score of 40 marks in their tests. A group of a different four students had a mean score of 60 marks. What is their combined mean score?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-22.prompt: A triangle is made from the lines $y=x$, $y=1$ and $x+y=8$. What is its area?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-23.prompt: $x$, $y$ and $z$ satisfy $x+y=11$, $y+z=15$ and $x+z=8$. What is the value of $x+y+z$?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-24.prompt: Alan wants to fill in the $4\times4$ square so that the letters U, K, M and T occur once each in every row and column, and in both main diagonals. The given letters are: row 1: U, T in the first two squares; row 2: K in the second square; row 3: M in the third square. Which letter must go in the square with the question mark (row 3, last square)?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-25.prompt: Four semicircles are drawn inside a square with sides of length 10 cm (as shown, each side of the square is the diameter of a semicircle). What is the sum of the total length of the curved lines and the total length of the straight lines? Give your answer in terms of $\pi$.

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-26.prompt: A logo consists of four shapes as shown in the diagram: a triangle, a circle, a square, and a pentagon. Each of the shapes is to be coloured in with a different colour: red, green, blue, and white. In how many different ways can the logo be coloured in?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-27.prompt: Ursula, Kaleb, Manjula and Taiwo each run a leg of a $4\times400$ m relay. Ursula runs at an average speed of 24 km/h. Kaleb runs a leg in exactly 1 minute. Manjula starts fast and runs the first 200 m in 25 seconds, but runs the last 200 m at half this speed. Taiwo runs the fastest leg by 5 seconds. What was the total time for the team in seconds?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-28.prompt: An acid is diluted with water such that there is 1 litre of acid for every 5 litres of water. One litre of this mixture is added to 4 litres of water. What is the ratio of acid to water in this new mix?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-29.prompt: Jim and Kim live 30 miles apart and plan to meet up partway between their homes. Jim takes a train which travels at twice the speed of Kim's car. The train travels at 60 mph. How long do they each travel for, in minutes?

ukmt-tmc-2025-regional-relay-30.prompt: What is the size of the obtuse angle between the hands of a clock when the time is 8:25?
